stories.source_title_el: Οι άστεγοι Κυπελλούχοι και το γήπεδο που έλειπε
stories.title_en: The Cup Winners Without a Home Ground
stories.lead_en: Two Greek Cups, nineteen months without an indoor arena—and the paradox of a team with trophies but nowhere suitable to play.

stories.source_title_el: Από το παλιό γήπεδο του Πάρκου μέχρι τη Γαλλία
stories.title_en: From the Old Park Stadium to France
stories.lead_en: How a sports section that started at the city's old ground went on to Olympic and European school-level distinctions.

stories.source_title_el: Το τόξο που έψαχνε γήπεδο και βρήκε ομοσπονδία
stories.title_en: The Bow That Needed a Range and Found a Federation
stories.lead_en: From early registrations at a shooting range and moves between training grounds to championship-level competition in Florina.

stories.source_title_el: Ο Παναθηναϊκός στην αυλή του σχολείου
stories.title_en: Panathinaikos in the Schoolyard
stories.lead_en: A 1975 volleyball friendly with a major club, played in the courtyard of the Boys' Secondary School.

stories.source_title_el: Πρώτα φτιάξαμε αίθουσα. Μετά ήρθαν τα μετάλλια.
stories.title_en: First We Built a Training Hall. Then Came the Medals.
stories.lead_en: The wrestling hall funded by the club, and the continuation of a tradition that reached the world stage.

stories.source_title_el: Πέντε χρυσά στην Καλαμάτα, αλλά η πισίνα δεν περίσσευε
stories.title_en: Five Golds in Kalamata, Yet No Pool Time to Spare
stories.lead_en: From the first lessons in 1981 and the Papadopouleia meets to finswimming, which stopped because training hours were unavailable.

stories.source_title_el: Οι πρωταθλητές, η αποθήκη του σταθμού και οι 112,59 βαθμοί
stories.title_en: Champions, a Station Storeroom, and 112.59 Points
stories.lead_en: Who said artistic gymnastics only takes balance? Sometimes it also takes ingenuity to find a place to train.

stories.source_title_el: Δύο ονόματα, μία φανέλα και μια μεγάλη απόφαση
stories.title_en: Two Names, One Jersey, and a Major Decision
stories.lead_en: In 2008, Katerini basketball decided to join forces. This 'transfer' involved entire sports sections, not a single athlete.

stories.source_title_el: Δεκαοκτώ σωματεία, δεκαπέντε πόλεις — και ο λογαριασμός στον Αρχέλαο
stories.title_en: Eighteen Clubs, Fifteen Cities—and the Bill for Archelaos
stories.lead_en: At the sixth Dia Games, the great challenge was not only athletic performance, but hosting every visiting delegation.

stories.source_title_el: Πώς ένα ταρτάν κράτησε τα Δίια στην αναμονή
stories.title_en: How a Tartan Track Kept the Dia Games Waiting
stories.lead_en: Stadium works postponed the games, but their return in 1985 brought a historic performance.

stories.source_title_el: Δύο αγώνες με την Τιφλίδα και το ευρωπαϊκό εισιτήριο που δεν χαρίστηκε
stories.title_en: Two Matches Against Tbilisi and a European Berth That Was Earned
stories.lead_en: In 1995, Archelaos defeated Mamuli Tbilisi twice. The scores tell the story of a European adventure.

stories.source_title_el: Οι αφανείς βάρδιες του χάντμπολ: Λάκης και Πόπη Χαρικλειά
stories.title_en: The Unsung Shifts Behind Handball: Lakis and Popi Charikleia
stories.lead_en: A team official looking for solutions in the top division, a vice-president following the youth teams, and a sports-medicine programme well ahead of its time.

stories.source_title_el: Ο έφορος, τα ξενοδοχεία και οι επιχορηγήσεις που αργούσαν
stories.title_en: The Team Official, the Hotels, and the Late Grants
stories.lead_en: Vasilis Efkarpidis, the work behind handball and volleyball, and expenses that could not wait for the next grant.

stories.source_title_el: Ο πόλεμος άλλαξε την έδρα, όχι το ταξίδι του Αρχέλαου
stories.title_en: War Changed the Venue, Not Archelaos's Journey
stories.lead_en: In 1993, a European handball match with Croatia's Umag took the delegation to Izola, Slovenia, when borders and venues were far from certain.

stories.source_title_el: Η πισίνα έκλεισε και οι κολυμβητές έμειναν να περιμένουν
stories.title_en: The Pool Closed and the Swimmers Were Left Waiting
stories.lead_en: In 1992, work to cover the pool forced families and club officials to face a difficult question: how could training continue without a pool?

stories.source_title_el: Η αποστολή του στίβου και τα μπλόκα στην εθνική οδό
stories.title_en: The Athletics Team and the Highway Roadblocks
stories.lead_en: In 2016, travelling to the Greek Indoor Athletics Championships became part of the challenge, as farmers' roadblocks stood on the route to Athens.

stories.source_title_el: Οι αγώνες τελείωσαν, ο λογαριασμός όχι: 30.000 δραχμές για τα Δίια
stories.title_en: The Meet Ended, the Bills Did Not: 30,000 Drachmas for the Dia Games
stories.lead_en: A November 1974 resolution reveals the unseen cost of a sporting celebration: after the games ended, obligations still had to be paid.

stories.source_title_el: Κέρδισε την έγχρωμη τηλεόραση και επέστρεψε κάτι στον Αρχέλαο
stories.title_en: He Won the Colour Television and Gave Back to Archelaos
stories.lead_en: A 1982 raffle left an unexpected gesture in the minutes: winner Konstantinos Demertzidis donated 10,000 drachmas to the club.

stories.source_title_el: Το βόλεϊ προπονούνταν όταν το γυμναστήριο είχε σχολάσει
stories.title_en: Volleyball Training After the Gym Closed
stories.lead_en: In 1987, the men's volleyball team needed time at the sports centre. The solution came after regular hours, at a cost of 12,000 drachmas a month.

stories.source_title_el: Το αρχείο που βρέθηκε σε άλλα γραφεία
stories.title_en: The Archive That Turned Up in Other Offices
stories.lead_en: In 1994, the board learnt that material from Archelaos's historical archive had been found at KAP's offices—a curious episode about the documents that keep memory alive.

stories.source_title_el: Να παίξουμε και τα δύο ευρωπαϊκά στην Ισπανία;
stories.title_en: Could We Play Both European Matches in Spain?
stories.lead_en: In 1994, ahead of the Granollers match, travel costs became the subject of a genuine European negotiation.
